body:
I have 'lost the magic', and I am beyond hurt that this has happened.
I am a veteran user of MDMA.  My history with the substance began at the age of nineteen.  Within, a year I consumed more than 100 pills and countless grams of pure MDMA.  During the peak of my use, I would have to consume at least four pills, to obtain the experience I knew from my first few times.
I ceased use after an unpleasant MDMA overdose
I ceased use after an unpleasant MDMA overdose
, resulting in projectile vomitting, blackouts and what I am told uncontrolled anger.  However, I only remember the vomitting and pleasant effects.
It has now been ten years, since my last dose of MDMA.  I obtained one gram of MDMA.  Reagent test went straight purple and immediately to black.  The product I had was MDMA.
I dosed 120mg initially, in a home setting, with all the party essentials; music, vibe, glow sticks, vapor rub, etc.  I was beyond prepared to make this a great experience.  I felt for a period of two minutes, tingling similar to the onset of the come up; however, this two minute experience was over 1.5 hours after my first dose.  I then followed up with an 80mg dose.  Nothing further took place.
I have lost the magic!  I take no medication that would interact with MDMA.  I began researching the next day.  I stumbled upon the serotonin syndrome.  You guessed it.  I have all the symptoms.  For close to a decade, I had anxiety, tremors, obsessions, irritability and so forth.
At this point, I am happy to know why I am not like most people.
Play safe and don't lose the magic!
